timing: Existing full outputs were already available and discussed. This split is fixed before secondary calculation, not before original data generation, and is not a confirmatory preregistration.
excluded_design: zero_covariance_dependence has different null membership for KCI and covariance tests; not part of the common-null power comparison.
native_score: native pvalue, smaller means more evidence; no fitted remapping or threshold tuning
rank_pvalue: (1 + count(calibration native p <= evaluation native p))/151
marginal_null_bound: 7/151 under exchangeable calibration/new-null draws and a fixed native score; ties are conservative; not conditional-on-bank validity.
source_independence: Original generator uses seed_start + cell_index*100000 + replication; null calibration, null validation and positive-alternative seeds are disjoint. Verify seed and sample hashes before calculation.
summaries: All 48 method/regime/null-or-positive cells; conditional-on-bank Wilson95 intervals. These intervals do not assess the marginal Monte Carlo validity theorem.
paired_comparisons: All 15 method pairs in all four positive-covariance regimes, exact two-sided discordance/binomial tests, Holm correction over all60. Conditional-on-calibration-bank comparisons only.
cost: 150 fully observed oracle null datasets per regime, each with n=400, supplied by the known generating law; not free deployable calibration labels.
interpretation: One retrospective independent-bank analysis, not a new forecasting model or confirmation of actual panel assumptions. No universal superiority conclusion, no data-dependent omitted cell, no repeat split.
publication_relocation: Only source/output paths relocated after the analysis; original freeze hash retained.
